description: This source file defines a speech processing pipeline in Swift, utilizing AVFoundation and Speech frameworks. It includes structures and classes for handling speech segments, errors, and orchestrating a speech recognition pipeline with audio input handling, transcriber and analyzer coordination, and error management.

classes.name: SpeechPipeline
classes.description: An actor that manages the speech recognition pipeline, including audio input, transcription, and analysis.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition process with specified locale and etiquette options, returning an asynchronous stream of speech segments.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the speech recognition pipeline, cancels ongoing tasks, and finalizes processing.

methods.name: handleBuffer
methods.description: Converts an audio buffer to the target format and feeds it into the analyzer input stream.

methods.name: requestAuthorizationIfNeeded
methods.description: Requests speech recognition authorization if not already granted.
